item.title: Kofu Castle Ruins (Maizuru Castle Park): The City's Central Historic Park — Guide
item.description: Kofu Castle, also known as Maizuru Castle, was built in the late 16th century, and while the main keep no longer stands, its impressive surviving stone walls, gates and reconstructed turrets remain at the heart of Kofu City as Maizuru Castle Park. The park is a pleasant central green space just a short walk from Kofu Station, with climbable stonework offering views over the city toward the surrounding mountains, making it an easy, free stop for visitors exploring central Kofu on foot.
